newsitem.title: CHINA: China province to spend $1.7 bln on pollution.
newsitem.headline: China province to spend $1.7 bln on pollution.

text.p: China's southern Guangdong province is to spend up to 14.4 billion yuan ($1.73 billion) over the next five years to clean up the Pearl River delta, the Xinhua news agency said on Monday.
The booming province had started or was planning 14 environmental protection projects including waste water disposal plants and facilities for controlling acid rain, the agency said.
Funds for the projects would come from foreign investors, resource-usage fees and ecological funds, the agency said without giving further details.
The Pearl River delta is dotted with thousands of factories, the vast majority of which operate with no pollution control facilities.
